citation.title: Metabolic, hormonal and glycan changes during a 72-hour water-only fast: a pilot study

reported.what: fasting glucose at T0 (before), T1 (end of 72 h water-only fast) and T2 (11 days later), n=5, median (min-max)
fasting insulin at T0, T1 and T2, n=5, median (min-max)
morning cortisol at T0, T1 and T2, n=5, median (min-max)

detail: Every value in Table 1 is a median with min-max (footnote: 'Values are presented as median (min-max)') for five people; the paper prints no mean, SD or SEM for glucose, insulin or cortisol, and the statistic list has no median.
